enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Sleep. Wake up briefly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
Turn on bathroom light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off faucet. Turn off light.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Place bowl in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Take out phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord to request stop. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace entrance. Open door. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Clock in. Put on lab coat. Wash hands. Check schedule. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Ask patient questions. Record notes. Walk to nurses station. Use computer. Update patient records. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check email. Read news. Put phone away. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord to request stop. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to home entrance. Open door. Walk inside.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, using fan to avoid AC during peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Check time. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and reading, continuing to avoid AC during peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Open laptop. Type password. Open document. Read document. Type notes. Open book. Read pages. Take notes. Turn page. Read more pages. Close book. Open email. Check email. Reply to email. Close laptop. Turn off computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and using computer, turning on AC after peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on bed. Change channel. Watch TV. Open laptop. Check email. Type reply. Close laptop. Turn on AC. Adjust temperature. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Walk out.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep.
